primary_battery_level.low: Primary battery critically low — return to base or switch to secondary battery immediately.
primary_battery_level.below_nominal: Primary battery slightly below nominal — monitor consumption and plan for recharge.
primary_battery_level.above_nominal: Primary battery above nominal — no action needed, within acceptable range.
primary_battery_level.high: Primary battery reading unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

secondary_battery_level.low: Secondary battery critically low — primary battery is now the only power source, plan return to base immediately.
secondary_battery_level.below_nominal: Secondary battery slightly below nominal — monitor consumption rate.
secondary_battery_level.above_nominal: Secondary battery above nominal — no action needed.
secondary_battery_level.high: Secondary battery reading unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

battery_level.low: Battery critically low — return to base or connect to external power source immediately.
battery_level.below_nominal: Battery below nominal — monitor power usage and plan for recharge.
battery_level.above_nominal: Battery above nominal — no action needed.
battery_level.high: Battery reading unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxy_pri_storage.low: Primary oxygen storage critically low — switch to secondary supply and terminate EVA.
oxy_pri_storage.below_nominal: Primary oxygen storage below nominal — monitor consumption rate and prepare contingency.
oxy_pri_storage.above_nominal: Primary oxygen storage above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_pri_storage.high: Primary oxygen storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxy_sec_storage.low: Secondary oxygen storage critically low — primary oxygen is now the only supply, plan immediate EVA termination.
oxy_sec_storage.below_nominal: Secondary oxygen storage below nominal — monitor and be prepared to terminate EVA.
oxy_sec_storage.above_nominal: Secondary oxygen storage above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_sec_storage.high: Secondary oxygen storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxy_pri_pressure.low: Primary oxygen pressure critically low — switch to secondary oxygen supply and begin EVA termination.
oxy_pri_pressure.below_nominal: Primary oxygen pressure below nominal — monitor and prepare to switch to secondary supply.
oxy_pri_pressure.above_nominal: Primary oxygen pressure above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_pri_pressure.high: Primary oxygen pressure dangerously high — risk of regulator failure; switch to secondary supply immediately.

oxy_sec_pressure.low: Secondary oxygen pressure critically low — verify primary supply is adequate and plan EVA termination.
oxy_sec_pressure.below_nominal: Secondary oxygen pressure below nominal — inspect secondary regulator.
oxy_sec_pressure.above_nominal: Secondary oxygen pressure above nominal — no action needed.
oxy_sec_pressure.high: Secondary oxygen pressure dangerously high — risk of regulator failure; do not use secondary supply.

suit_pressure_oxy.low: Suit oxygen partial pressure critically low — potential hypoxia risk; begin emergency egress.
suit_pressure_oxy.below_nominal: Suit oxygen partial pressure slightly below nominal — monitor breathing comfort and check oxygen flow.
suit_pressure_oxy.above_nominal: Suit oxygen partial pressure above nominal — check oxygen regulator for over-delivery.
suit_pressure_oxy.high: Suit oxygen partial pressure dangerously high — risk of oxygen toxicity; reduce flow rate immediately.

suit_pressure_co2.low: Suit CO2 partial pressure below range — verify scrubber function and sensor calibration.
suit_pressure_co2.below_nominal: Suit CO2 partial pressure below nominal — verify scrubber is not over-performing.
suit_pressure_co2.above_nominal: Suit CO2 partial pressure above nominal — monitor scrubber efficiency and metabolic rate.
suit_pressure_co2.high: Suit CO2 partial pressure critically high — scrubber may be failing; begin emergency egress immediately.

suit_pressure_other.low: Suit other gas partial pressure below range — check suit integrity and sensor calibration.
suit_pressure_other.below_nominal: Suit other gas partial pressure below nominal — monitor suit atmosphere composition.
suit_pressure_other.above_nominal: Suit other gas partial pressure above nominal — check for atmospheric contamination.
suit_pressure_other.high: Suit other gas partial pressure critically high — potential atmospheric contamination; begin emergency egress.

suit_pressure_total.low: Total suit pressure critically low — possible suit breach; begin emergency egress immediately.
suit_pressure_total.below_nominal: Total suit pressure slightly below nominal — inspect suit seals and joints.
suit_pressure_total.above_nominal: Total suit pressure above nominal — check pressure regulation system.
suit_pressure_total.high: Total suit pressure dangerously high — risk of suit failure; reduce pressure immediately.

helmet_pressure_co2.low: Helmet CO2 pressure below range — verify sensor calibration.
helmet_pressure_co2.below_nominal: Helmet CO2 pressure below nominal — scrubber may be over-performing; verify sensor.
helmet_pressure_co2.above_nominal: Helmet CO2 pressure above nominal — increase ventilation and monitor scrubber performance.
helmet_pressure_co2.high: Helmet CO2 pressure critically high — hypercapnia risk; activate emergency purge and begin egress.

fan_pri_rpm.low: Primary fan RPM critically low — ventilation compromised; switch to secondary fan immediately.
fan_pri_rpm.below_nominal: Primary fan RPM below nominal — check fan motor and power supply.
fan_pri_rpm.above_nominal: Primary fan RPM above nominal — fan running faster than expected; monitor for overheating.
fan_pri_rpm.high: Primary fan RPM dangerously high — risk of fan failure; switch to secondary fan immediately.

fan_sec_rpm.low: Secondary fan RPM critically low — if primary fan is also degraded, ventilation is at risk; investigate immediately.
fan_sec_rpm.below_nominal: Secondary fan RPM below nominal — check secondary fan motor and power supply.
fan_sec_rpm.above_nominal: Secondary fan RPM above nominal — fan running faster than expected; monitor for overheating.
fan_sec_rpm.high: Secondary fan RPM dangerously high — risk of fan failure; rely on primary fan only.

scrubber_a_co2_storage.low: Scrubber A CO2 storage below range — verify sensor calibration.
scrubber_a_co2_storage.below_nominal: Scrubber A CO2 storage below nominal — no action needed, scrubber has capacity.
scrubber_a_co2_storage.above_nominal: Scrubber A CO2 storage above nominal — monitor scrubber saturation level.
scrubber_a_co2_storage.high: Scrubber A CO2 storage at capacity — switch to Scrubber B and replace Scrubber A immediately.

scrubber_b_co2_storage.low: Scrubber B CO2 storage below range — verify sensor calibration.
scrubber_b_co2_storage.below_nominal: Scrubber B CO2 storage below nominal — no action needed, scrubber has capacity.
scrubber_b_co2_storage.above_nominal: Scrubber B CO2 storage above nominal — monitor scrubber saturation level.
scrubber_b_co2_storage.high: Scrubber B CO2 storage at capacity — switch to Scrubber A and replace Scrubber B immediately.

temperature.low: Suit temperature critically low — risk of hypothermia; increase heater output.
temperature.below_nominal: Suit temperature below nominal — check heater settings and increase if needed.
temperature.above_nominal: Suit temperature above nominal — reduce activity or increase cooling.
temperature.high: Suit temperature dangerously high — risk of heat stroke; reduce activity and increase cooling immediately.

coolant_storage.low: Coolant storage critically low — thermal regulation at risk; reduce activity and prepare to terminate EVA.
coolant_storage.below_nominal: Coolant storage below nominal — monitor coolant consumption rate.
coolant_storage.above_nominal: Coolant storage above nominal — no action needed.
coolant_storage.high: Coolant storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

coolant_gas_pressure.low: Coolant gas pressure below range — check coolant system integrity.
coolant_gas_pressure.below_nominal: Coolant gas pressure below nominal — verify coolant gas reservoir.
coolant_gas_pressure.above_nominal: Coolant gas pressure above nominal — check for blockage in coolant gas lines.
coolant_gas_pressure.high: Coolant gas pressure dangerously high — risk of line rupture; reduce pressure immediately.

coolant_liquid_pressure.low: Coolant liquid pressure critically low — pump may be failing; thermal regulation at risk.
coolant_liquid_pressure.below_nominal: Coolant liquid pressure below nominal — check coolant pump and lines for leaks.
coolant_liquid_pressure.above_nominal: Coolant liquid pressure above nominal — check for blockage in coolant liquid lines.
coolant_liquid_pressure.high: Coolant liquid pressure dangerously high — risk of line rupture; check coolant pump and valves.

heart_rate.low: Heart rate critically low — possible medical emergency; halt EVA and contact flight surgeon.
heart_rate.below_nominal: Heart rate below nominal — monitor astronaut condition and reduce activity if needed.
heart_rate.above_nominal: Heart rate above nominal — consider reducing activity pace.
heart_rate.high: Heart rate dangerously high — halt EVA activity immediately and contact flight surgeon.

oxy_consumption.low: Oxygen consumption rate below range — verify sensor and check astronaut is breathing normally.
oxy_consumption.below_nominal: Oxygen consumption below nominal — monitor astronaut activity level.
oxy_consumption.above_nominal: Oxygen consumption above nominal — high metabolic rate; reduce activity pace.
oxy_consumption.high: Oxygen consumption critically high — oxygen supply will deplete faster; reduce activity and plan early return.

co2_production.low: CO2 production rate below range — verify sensor calibration.
co2_production.below_nominal: CO2 production below nominal — monitor astronaut activity level.
co2_production.above_nominal: CO2 production above nominal — high metabolic rate; reduce activity and monitor scrubber performance.
co2_production.high: CO2 production critically high — scrubber may be overwhelmed; reduce activity and monitor helmet CO2 levels.

throttle.low: Rover throttle below range — verify throttle control system.
throttle.below_nominal: Rover throttle below nominal — no action needed unless unexpected.
throttle.above_nominal: Rover throttle above nominal — monitor speed and terrain conditions.
throttle.high: Rover throttle at maximum — reduce speed if terrain is uneven or obstacles are present.

steering.low: Rover steering at full left lock — verify intentional and check for steering system faults.
steering.below_nominal: Rover steering left of nominal — verify intentional.
steering.above_nominal: Rover steering right of nominal — verify intentional.
steering.high: Rover steering at full right lock — verify intentional and check for steering system faults.

pitch.low: Rover pitch critically negative — steep downhill grade; reduce speed to prevent tipping.
pitch.below_nominal: Rover pitch below nominal — monitor terrain slope.
pitch.above_nominal: Rover pitch above nominal — monitor terrain slope.
pitch.high: Rover pitch critically positive — steep uphill grade; reduce speed and check traction.

roll.low: Rover roll below range — verify sensor calibration.
roll.below_nominal: Rover roll below nominal — terrain is level; no action needed.
roll.above_nominal: Rover roll above nominal — monitor lateral stability on uneven terrain.
roll.high: Rover roll critically high — risk of rollover; reduce speed and steer toward level ground immediately.

distance_traveled.low: Rover distance traveled below range — verify odometer sensor.
distance_traveled.below_nominal: Rover distance traveled below nominal — no action needed.
distance_traveled.above_nominal: Rover distance traveled above nominal — monitor mission timeline.
distance_traveled.high: Rover distance traveled at limit — evaluate remaining battery and oxygen before continuing.

speed.low: Rover speed below range — verify speed sensor calibration.
speed.below_nominal: Rover speed below nominal — no action needed.
speed.above_nominal: Rover speed above nominal — monitor terrain conditions.
speed.high: Rover speed critically high — reduce speed immediately; risk of loss of control on lunar terrain.

surface_incline.low: Surface incline critically steep downward — reduce speed immediately to prevent loss of control.
surface_incline.below_nominal: Surface incline below nominal — monitor terrain descent.
surface_incline.above_nominal: Surface incline above nominal — monitor terrain ascent.
surface_incline.high: Surface incline critically steep upward — rover may lose traction; reduce speed and assess route.

oxygen_storage.low: Rover oxygen storage critically low — immediately return to base to resupply.
oxygen_storage.below_nominal: Rover oxygen storage below nominal — monitor consumption and plan return timeline.
oxygen_storage.above_nominal: Rover oxygen storage above nominal — no action needed.
oxygen_storage.high: Rover oxygen storage unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.

oxygen_pressure.low: Rover oxygen pressure critically low — regulator may be failing; switch to backup supply.
oxygen_pressure.below_nominal: Rover oxygen pressure below nominal — inspect oxygen regulator and lines.
oxygen_pressure.above_nominal: Rover oxygen pressure above nominal — check regulator for over-pressure.
oxygen_pressure.high: Rover oxygen pressure dangerously high — risk of regulator failure; reduce pressure immediately.

cabin_pressure.low: Rover cabin pressure critically low — possible breach; don suits and begin emergency protocol.
cabin_pressure.below_nominal: Rover cabin pressure slightly below nominal — inspect cabin seals.
cabin_pressure.above_nominal: Rover cabin pressure above nominal — check pressure regulation system.
cabin_pressure.high: Rover cabin pressure dangerously high — risk of structural failure; vent pressure immediately.

cabin_temperature.low: Rover cabin temperature critically low — risk of hypothermia; activate cabin heating.
cabin_temperature.below_nominal: Rover cabin temperature below nominal — increase heating.
cabin_temperature.above_nominal: Rover cabin temperature above nominal — no action needed unless approaching limit.
cabin_temperature.high: Rover cabin temperature critically high — risk of heat exhaustion; activate cooling and reduce solar exposure.

coolant_pressure.low: Rover coolant pressure critically low — coolant pump may be failing; reduce system load.
coolant_pressure.below_nominal: Rover coolant pressure below nominal — check coolant pump and inspect for leaks.
coolant_pressure.above_nominal: Rover coolant pressure above nominal — check for blockage in coolant lines.
coolant_pressure.high: Rover coolant pressure dangerously high — risk of line rupture; shut down coolant pump and investigate.

distance_from_base.low: Rover distance from base below range — verify GPS sensor.
distance_from_base.below_nominal: Rover distance from base below nominal — no action needed.
distance_from_base.above_nominal: Rover distance from base above nominal — monitor return route feasibility.
distance_from_base.high: Rover distance from base at limit — turn back immediately to ensure safe return with remaining resources.

oxygen_tank.low: Rover oxygen tank critically low — return to base for resupply immediately.
oxygen_tank.below_nominal: Rover oxygen tank below nominal — monitor usage rate and adjust mission timeline.
oxygen_tank.above_nominal: Rover oxygen tank above nominal — no action needed.
oxygen_tank.high: Rover oxygen tank unexpectedly high — verify sensor calibration.
